input: One unboxed grayscale SAR display image per model call.
question: What target category is shown in this SAR image? Choose one of: ship, aircraft, car, oil storage tank, bridge, harbor. Answer in a clear natural sentence.

full.purpose: Measure source target hits and cross-model transfer.

ablation.purpose: Isolate the effect of the visual cosine term.

admission: Resolve reference category, whole-image task fit, scene relationships and applicable usage terms before freezing. Eligibility for the paired phase also requires a jointly correct clean answer and source generation format compatibility. Keep preview candidates out of tuning and model-based selection.
reporting: Separate planned, completed, failed, timed-out, manually stopped and unexecuted items. Report correct, designated target, other incorrect and indeterminate answers separately. Retain original answers locally. In the separate image-text study, transcription establishes readability for its own prompt. Absence of a targeted answer alone leaves defense effectiveness undetermined.
